issues.fact: Both candidate runs reproduce the observed internal cross-section flow (FC1 sim 1647.4 vs real 1646.9 veh/h/lane; FC2 sim 1451.4 vs real 1439.2 veh/h/lane) yet sit on the free-flow branch: 20-22 m/s at about 20 veh/km/lane instead of 8-10.5 m/s at 43-50 veh/km/lane.
issues.impact: Layer 5 state support fails for both target conditions, so no five-layer conjunction can be evaluated and the simulated local P2 is not comparable to the real local P2.
issues.validation: Both runs completed with zero engineering blockers, zero numerical blockers, zero conservation and local-balance residuals, no pending vehicles and a 100% exact-branch pass rate inside the verified fresh/no-stop domain.
issues.resolution: Stopped per the frozen pre-declared rule; no third construction run and no independent-seed repeat executed. The cause is the conditional-supply design, not a numerical failure.
issues.researcher_decision: D3 target-condition and boundary-supply design, then D5 budget reuse

issues.fact: Simulated closing-speed means are positive (2.73 and 3.67 m/s) while both real windows are negative (-0.17 and -0.11 m/s); simulated low-speed share is 0.00047 and 0.04210 against 0.09689 and 0.25297 real.
issues.impact: Layer 2 interaction regime and layer 1 speed distribution differ in sign, not only magnitude, so a margin discussion is not yet meaningful.
issues.validation: Recomputed from the archived metric files on both sides.
issues.resolution: Recorded as a factual difference; no behaviour-parameter search was run to force agreement.

issues.fact: FC1 produced zero local onset events inside the frozen evaluation window although its global confirmed-event count is 84; FC2 produced 22 onset events at 56.23 per evaluable vehicle-hour against real 17.04 and 23.50.
issues.impact: A zero numerator with a non-zero global count is a state-support artefact, not evidence of a safe state; the non-zero run is not rescued by being closer in magnitude either.
issues.validation: Event and cluster tables recounted independently; interval semantics preserved.
issues.resolution: No window shortened, no seed swapped, no event rule altered, no run hidden.

issues.fact: No independent measurement-error bound exists anywhere in the closed stages, so the approved error rule cannot be evaluated even in principle at present.
issues.impact: Scientific delta and precision h stay unapproved, so Stage 0.5 cannot pass regardless of simulator state support.
issues.validation: The basis audit lists every candidate source and states why each fails to constitute a bound.
issues.resolution: equivalence() returns Awaiting Researcher Decision rather than defaulting; no numeric threshold invented.

issues.fact: Three earlier work capsules remain on disk recording superseded preparation attempts: a pytest basetemp collision, a memory-limit stop at 3.23 GB against the unchanged 3 GiB cap, and a string lane_id region filter that produced an empty local set caught by the zero-exposure guard.
issues.impact: Only the v4 capsule is the executed and verified reference run; earlier attempts must not be read as results.
issues.validation: All v4 frozen-file hashes verified; v1-v3 excluded from the evidence export.
issues.resolution: Kept locally as history, excluded from portable evidence, and disclosed here.

issues.fact: The candidate plan fixes window_s [180.0, 299.7] while the real reference windows are [120.0, 840.0] and [180.0, 840.0]; they are different objects, a 300 s finite-time simulator sample versus 720/660 s of real interior support.
issues.impact: Exposure per run is 1458.1 and 1408.4 vehicle-seconds against real 31051.6 and 33091.1, an order of magnitude lower, so even with state support the interval width would dominate.
issues.validation: Recorded in the budget and handoff files.
issues.resolution: Reported as the minimum resource change required, without raising any authorized cap.
